v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Heródes irátus * occídit multos púeros in Béthlehem Iudæ civitáte David.
text.en: Herod was exceeding wroth, * and slew many children in Bethlehem of Judah, the city of David.

text.la: A bimátu * et infra occídit multos púeros Heródes propter Dóminum.
text.en: Herod slew many children * from two years old, and under, for the Lord's sake.

text.la: Angeli eórum * semper vident fáciem Patris.
text.en: Their angels * do always behold the face of the Father.

text.la: Vox in Rama * audíta est, plorátus et ululátus, Rachel plorans fílios suos.
text.en: In Rama was there a voice * heard, weeping and mourning, Rachel weeping for her children.

text.la: Sub throno Dei * omnes Sancti clamant: Víndica sánguinem nostrum, Deus noster.
text.en: Under the throne of God * all the saints cry aloud: Avenge our blood, O our God!

text.la: Vidi supra montem Sion Agnum stantem, et cum eo centum quadragínta quátuor míllia habéntes nomen eius, et nomen Patris eius scriptum in fróntibus suis.
text.en: Lo, a lamb stood upon mount Sion, and with him an hundred forty-four thousand, having his name, and the name of his Father, written on their foreheads.

v.en: Herod being wroth, slew many children.

r.en: In Bethlehem of Juda, the city of David.

text.la: Hi sunt, * qui cum muliéribus non sunt coinquináti: vírgines enim sunt, et sequúntur Agnum quocúmque íerit.
text.en: These are they * who were not defiled with women; for they are virgins, and follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth.

text.la: Deus, cuius hodiérna die præcónium Innocéntes Mártyres non loquéndo, sed moriéndo conféssi sunt: ómnia in nobis vitiórum mala mortífica; ut fidem tuam, quam lingua nostra lóquitur, étiam móribus vita fateátur.
text.en: O God, whose praise the martyred Innocents on this day confessed, not by speaking, but by dying, destroy all the evils of sin in us, that our life also may proclaim in deeds, thy faith which our tongues profess.

text.la: Glória in excélsis Deo, et in terra pax homínibus bonæ voluntátis, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: Glory be to God in the highest; and on earth, peace to men of good will, alleluia, alleluia.

v.en: The Lord hath made known, alleluia.

text.la: Concéde, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut nos Unigéniti tui nova per carnem Natívitas líberet; quos sub peccáti iugo vetústa sérvitus tenet.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, almighty God, that the new birth of thy Only-begotten Son as man may set us free, who are held by the old bondage under the yoke of sin.
